from cache import make_key

def test_make_key_all_inputs_affect_caching():
    # Test that changing any input produces a different key
    k1 = make_key("text", "profile1", "criteria1")
    k2 = make_key("text", "profile2", "criteria1")  # changed profile
    assert k1 != k2, "Changing profile should change key"
    
    k3 = make_key("text", "profile1", "criteria2")  # changed criteria
    assert k1 != k3, "Changing criteria should change key"
    
    k4 = make_key("text2", "profile1", "criteria1")  # changed text
    assert k1 != k4, "Changing text should change key"

def test_make_key_none_handling():
    # Test that None values are handled consistently
    k5 = make_key(None, None, None)
    k6 = make_key("", "", "")
    # None and empty string should produce different keys
    assert k5 != k6, "None and empty string should produce different keys"
    
    # Same inputs should produce same key even with None
    k7 = make_key(None, None, None)
    assert k5 == k7, "Same inputs should produce same key"

def test_make_key_ambiguous_keys():
    # Test that we avoid ambiguous concatenation keys
    # Different combinations should not collide
    k8 = make_key("a", 1, 2)
    k9 = make_key("b", 1, 2)
    assert k8 != k9, "Different text values should produce different keys"
    
    k10 = make_key("a", 1, 2)
    k11 = make_key("a", 3, 4)
    assert k10 != k11, "Different profile/criteria should produce different keys"

def test_make_key_consistency():
    # Test that same inputs always produce same key
    k12 = make_key("test", "p1", "c1")
    k13 = make_key("test", "p1", "c1")
    assert k12 == k13, "Same inputs should always produce same key"
